steps.name: Require exact publisher-supplied public v21 mapping
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PYMAP'
import json, os, re
from pathlib import Path
directory = Path('harness/verification/draft-pg-v21')
mapping = json.loads((directory / 'source-map.json').read_text())
plan = json.loads((directory / 'plan.json').read_text())
assert mapping['repository'] == 'salmonumbrella/mailflow'
assert mapping['accepted_private_sha'] == plan['source']['accepted_private_sha'] == 'bc538c0ae6827e8c94f5b824d5d12a881a5da092'
assert mapping['accepted_tree'] == plan['source']['tree'] == '85ee5f47109f0c01b8f595c32b88c3f26e24cd56'
assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', mapping['public_sha'] or ''), 'Public v21 mapping missing; no guessed source, install or SQL run'
with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as stream:
    stream.write('sha=' + mapping['public_sha'] + '\n')
PYMAP

steps.name: Check out exactly mapped accepted source
Run only ten draft-ingestion PostgreSQL cases
Clean only the recorded owned service
